verdicts.note: Exists: Bolero (D major), No. 2 of 2 Konzertstücke Op. 16 for violin & piano (Hainauer 1878, ded. Marianne Scharwenka-Stresow); only the Ballade was later orchestrated, so Piano is right. Only change: Naxos 8.573410 timing is 7:20, not 5.
IMSLP: 4 Morceaux Op. 82 for violin & piano (Peters 1909): No. 1 Les Nymphes (F minor, ends F major), ded. Pierre Sechiari. Naxos 8.573410 track 6 (4:57).
IMSLP: No. 2 Caprice (A minor), ded. Alberto Bachmann; opens with unaccompanied Baroque-style passage. Naxos track 7 (3:10), so about 3-4 min.
IMSLP: No. 3 Mélodie (G major), ded. Israel Mendels. Naxos track 8 (5:32), so about 5 min.
IMSLP: No. 4 Humoresque (D major), ded. George Enescu. Naxos track 9 (4:50).

gaps.title: Serenata, Op. 15 No. 1 (arr. Rehfeld)
gaps.scoring: violin and piano (arr. Fabian Rehfeld of the piano piece, No. 1 of 6 Klavierstücke Op. 15)
gaps.edition: Breslau: Julius Hainauer, [1883], plate J. 2516 H (IMSLP); recorded by Maud Powell (Victor 1912) and on Naxos 8.573410
gaps.note: Original piano Serenata is in D major (Andante grazioso); key of the violin version not seen, so left out of the title. Rehfeld also arranged it for cello, string quartet, orchestra (not listed).

gaps.title: Étincelles, Op. 36 No. 6 (arr. Heifetz)
gaps.scoring: violin and piano (Jascha Heifetz's transcription of 'Sparks', No. 6 of 8 Morceaux caractéristiques)
gaps.edition: Carl Fischer, New York (publisher credited in the Naxos 8.573410 booklet; no IMSLP score)
gaps.note: Piano original (1886) is in B-flat major, Allegro scherzando; key of the Heifetz version not confirmed so omitted from title. Recorded 1:33 on Naxos 8.573410.
